title: Account activity
description: Recent sign-ins, when you were last online and how your API keys are used. Only you and administrators can see this.
loadError: Account activity could not be loaded
sessionsHint: Web sign-ins that have not expired
apiRequestsHint: API key requests in the last {days} days
trendNote: Counted per UTC day and written at most once a minute per key, so the latest minute may not be included yet.
